about: The str_extract verb in a specification (TEXT-10). A group written as an integer wider than any machine integer is read as that integer, not as a float, and is refused as out of range with the whole number in its context. The case's row is the one its test built: phase, condition, rule and context from text_extract_reference.json's wide-group-pure-expression capture, at the group's spec path. Moved from the declarative_text_extract module of scalar_declarative_rounding.rs, whose test compared the one issue's phase, condition, rule, spec paths and context.
